steps.title: Why AI + Surgewave?
steps.text: Traditional search matches exact keywords. AI-enhanced processing understands semantic meaning, so a query for 'car problems' also finds documents about 'automobile issues' and 'vehicle trouble'.

steps.title: Embeddings: Text as Vectors
steps.text: Embeddings convert text into dense vectors of floating-point numbers that capture semantic meaning. Similar texts produce similar vectors. Surgewave supports OpenAI and local Ollama models for generating embeddings.

steps.title: RAG Pipeline Architecture
steps.text: RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) combines vector search with LLM generation. First embed the query, then find similar documents in a vector database, then let the LLM generate an answer using those documents as context.

steps.title: Vector Databases
steps.text: Qdrant stores embeddings and supports similarity search using cosine distance. Lesson 22.3 teaches you to store vectors and query them for nearest-neighbor results, which is the foundation of semantic search.

steps.title: Get Started
steps.text: Begin with Lesson 22.1 to generate your first embeddings with OpenAI, then progress through vector storage, RAG pipelines, and semantic search. Each lesson includes runnable code and exercises.
